subject.title: [Feature]: Semantic Message Aggregation: merge rapid-fire short messages and split multi-topic long messages

question: Should OpenClaw add semantic topic splitting and adaptive aggregation as a core/session-ingress capability, or keep only fixed inbound debounce plus narrower follow-up trackers?
rationale: The remaining request changes cross-channel turn boundaries and adds public config/API surface, which repository policy treats as product- and compatibility-sensitive rather than an automatic repair.

options.title: Narrow Generic Ingress Design
options.body: Approve one opt-in generic ingress or bundle contract, preserve current defaults, and keep semantic splitting behind explicit schema, docs, and tests.

options.title: Defer Semantic Splitting
options.body: Keep this issue open as product backlog, let the adaptive timing tracker own debounce changes, and do not add semantic topic analysis yet.

options.title: Fixed Debounce Only
options.body: Decide that fixed debounce is the supported core answer and ask semantic preprocessing experiments to live in a plugin or external integration.

recommendation.title: Narrow Generic Ingress Design
recommendation.body: Approve one opt-in generic ingress or bundle contract, preserve current defaults, and keep semantic splitting behind explicit schema, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest shared-policy history across inbound debounce and the product-review context for this area.
